title: Contain the Chaos: ‘CONTROL Resonant’ Launches on GeForce NOW
summary: Last chance for the ‘CONTROL Resonant’ Ultimate membership bundle, with GeForce NOW coming to Googlebooks and nine new games this week.
body_markdown:
A warped Manhattan is waiting in the cloud this week. Remedy Entertainment’s


[CONTROL Resonant](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-gdc-2026/) brings Dylan Faden’s extraordinary abilities and a paranatural crisis to


[GeForce NOW](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/) at launch.


With the release comes the final days of the


[CONTROL Resonant Ultimate Membership Bundle](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-gamescom-2026) . Purchase a 12-month GeForce NOW


[Ultimate membership](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/?ncid=pa-srch-goog-673352&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=24109411186&gbraid=0AAAAAD4XAoFI7Qv3JuyVS3JfsbTyEsT23&gclid=CjwKCAjwqJXUBhBNEiwA8BgG7tncwPMGvgxfIqAMVMDu9z52vqLYF50jDggeNGVpU_B29eyVk2YCKBoC_YMQAvD_BwE) through Sunday, Sept. 27, and receive


*CONTROL Resonant* at no additional cost.


GeForce NOW support is coming soon to


[Googlebooks](https://googlebook.google/) , a new category of laptops bringing together the best of ChromeOS and Android.


To top it off,


*DragonSword: Awakening* leads nine new games this week, bringing an anime-style open world to supported devices.


## **Take Control on the Cloud**


Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in Remedy Entertainment’s


*CONTROL Resonant* . Harness Dylan Faden’s extraordinary abilities to battle the Hiss, the Mold and other reality-bending threats while searching for his sister, Federal Bureau of CONTROL Director Jesse Faden.


Dylan must master his new powers and the ever-changing forms of the Aberrant, his paranatural melee weapon, to face a cosmic threat that has escaped the Oldest House and swept through the city.


Ultimate members can stream the next chapter of the


*CONTROL* franchise with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, including


[NVIDIA DLSS 4](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/technologies/dlss/) ,


[ray tracing](https://developer.nvidia.com/discover/ray-tracing) ,


[NVIDIA Reflex](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/technologies/reflex/) and Cinematic Quality Streaming technologies, with up to 5K high dynamic range on supported devices. Skip the 100GB local install and expensive PC upgrades, and step into the chaos the moment the mission begins.


The clock is ticking: the


*CONTROL Resonant* Ultimate Membership Bundle ends Sunday, Sept. 27.


## **Cloud Gaming Meets Googlebooks**


GeForce NOW support is coming soon to


[Googlebooks](https://googlebook.google/) — Google’s new category of laptops, and the first designed for Gemini Intelligence. Googlebook is crafted with premium materials for powerful performance. Secure by design, its Titan C chip and multigrade protection keep viruses out and hackers away. It also lets users jump from phone to laptop without skipping a beat, and access files and apps from phones directly on the laptop.


As Googlebooks begin rolling out this fall, GeForce NOW support will bring the cloud gaming library to the new laptop category, making it possible to stream the latest PC games with GeForce RTX-powered performance — and without local installs. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW social channels for more availability details later this year.


## **Awaken the Dragon Sword**


A dragon has awakened after 60 years, and the legacy of six heroes waits to be uncovered.


Hound13’s


*DragonSword: Awakening* transports players to the radiant, anime-style continent of Orbis, where Lute’s journey to become the hero known as the Dragon Sword begins. Explore meadows, secret cellars, deep seas, caves and dungeons alongside trusted allies and collectible Familiars.


Build a team from 19 heroes, stack Status Ailments with Active Skills and chain Signal Skills into spectacular tag-team combos. Each character carries a story of their own to uncover along the way.


The journey travels across supported devices, including


[Steam Decks](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-steam-deck-geforce-now/) ,


[Firefox browsers](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-firefox) and


[Amazon Fire TV devices](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-amazon-fire-tv-app/) , making players ready for the next adventure in Orbis. The Dragon Sword awaits.


In addition, members can look for the following games joining the cloud this week:


- *Dune: Awakening* (New release on


[Xbox](https://www.xbox.com/games/store/dune-awakening/9p2xq2ftv8jz?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Sept. 22, available on Game Pass)


- *Stick It to the Stickman* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085540?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Sept. 23)


- *CONTROL Resonant* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669870?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Sept. 24)


- *Wild West Pioneers* (New release on


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3222640?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) , Sept. 25)


- *DragonSword: Awakening* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4570720?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


- *Everything Is Crab* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3526710?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


- *LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215200?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


- *Over the Top: WWI* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778610?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


- *Roadside Research* (


[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643170?utm_source=nvidia&utm_campaign=geforce_now) )


Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after they’re released and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates to announced titles.


Those new to GeForce NOW can start with a


[day pass](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/?ncid=pa-srch-goog-673352&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23934057100&gbraid=0AAAAAD4XAoGnE9lpVE2P7s2w402M9Z88O&gclid=CjwKCAjwmozTBhAeEiwAkEGZzpLVIofm6Fb8NkgPbRUdjDh1f44tfDuIuNq5ZpkT2XfbB6EbuKByaxoCmzsQAvD_BwE) to try premium cloud gaming before committing to a membership. Better yet, the cost of a day pass can be applied toward a first monthly membership — making it easy to level up with GeForce RTX-powered cloud gaming.


Which cloud-bound adventure is calling this weekend? Let us know on


[X](https://x.com/NVIDIAGFN?lang=en) or in the comments below.
